script:
Script of the dog (dog): a quadruped robot dog: body actions, going places, searching, following, questions; each command accepted under the body's state or refused with a reason
- move stand: "I stand up."; needs cmd stand, posture(P), other(P,standing), battery ok (kept), idle (kept); leaves posture(standing), done(stand).
- move stand low: "I can't stand: the battery is too low to stand."; needs cmd stand, posture(P) (kept), other(P,standing), battery low (kept), idle (kept); leaves refused(stand).
- move stand already: "I am already standing."; needs cmd stand, posture(standing) (kept), idle (kept); leaves refused(stand).
- move sit: "I sit down."; needs cmd sit, posture(P), other(P,sitting), floor dry (kept), idle (kept); leaves posture(sitting), done(sit).
- move sit wet: "I can't sit: the floor here is wet."; needs cmd sit, posture(P) (kept), other(P,sitting), floor wet (kept), idle (kept); leaves refused(sit).
- move sit already: "I am already sitting."; needs cmd sit, posture(sitting) (kept), idle (kept); leaves refused(sit).
- move lie: "I lie down."; needs cmd lie, posture(P), other(P,lying), idle (kept); leaves posture(lying), done(lie).
- move lie already: "I am already lying down."; needs cmd lie, posture(lying) (kept), idle (kept); leaves refused(lie).
- move turn: "I turn the way you said."; needs cmd turn(S), posture(standing) (kept), free(S) (kept), idle (kept); leaves done(turn).
- move turn obstacle: "I can't turn that way: an obstacle is too close on that side."; needs cmd turn(S), posture(standing) (kept), obstacle(S) (kept), idle (kept); leaves refused(turn).
- move turn must stand: "I can't turn: I have to stand up first."; needs cmd turn(S), posture(P) (kept), other(P,standing), idle (kept); leaves refused(turn).
- move move: "I move the way you said."; needs cmd move(W), posture(standing) (kept), clear(W) (kept), idle (kept); leaves done(move).
- move move wall: "I can't move that way: there is a wall right there."; needs cmd move(W), posture(standing) (kept), wall(W) (kept), idle (kept); leaves refused(move).
- move move must stand: "I can't move: I have to stand up first."; needs cmd move(W), posture(P) (kept), other(P,standing), idle (kept); leaves refused(move).
- move paw: "I give you my paw."; needs cmd paw, leg ok (kept), idle (kept); leaves done(paw).
- move paw hot: "I can't lift my paw: my front leg is overheating."; needs cmd paw, leg hot (kept), idle (kept); leaves refused(paw).
- move sit busy: "I can't sit now: I am on a task."; needs cmd sit, busy (kept); leaves refused(sit).
- move lie busy: "I can't lie down now: I am on a task."; needs cmd lie, busy (kept); leaves refused(lie).
- move turn busy: "I can't turn now: I am on a task."; needs cmd turn(S), busy (kept); leaves refused(turn).
- move move busy: "I can't move now: I am on a task."; needs cmd move(W), busy (kept); leaves refused(move).
- move paw busy: "I can't give my paw now: I am on a task."; needs cmd paw, busy (kept); leaves refused(paw).
- move go: "I set off for {P}."; needs cmd go(P), idle, posture(standing) (kept), mapped(P) (kept), open(P) (kept); leaves moving(P), progress(go), busy.
- move go unmapped: "I can't go to {P}: it is not on my map."; needs cmd go(P), unmapped(P) (kept); leaves refused(go).
- move go closed: "I can't go to {P}: the way to it is closed."; needs cmd go(P), mapped(P) (kept), closed(P) (kept); leaves refused(go).
- move go must stand: "I can't go yet: I have to stand up first."; needs cmd go(P), idle (kept), mapped(P) (kept), open(P) (kept), posture(Q) (kept), other(Q,standing); leaves refused(go).
- move go busy: "I can't take that now: I am already busy with a task."; needs cmd go(P), moving(Q) (kept); leaves refused(go).
- move go busy find: "I can't take that now: I am searching."; needs cmd go(P), searching(T) (kept); leaves refused(go).
- move go busy follow: "I can't take that now: I am following you."; needs cmd go(P), following (kept); leaves refused(go).
- move arrive: "I have arrived at {P}."; needs moving(P), arrived(P), at(Q), busy; leaves at(P), idle, done(go).
- move go blocked: "I had to stop: the way to {P} is blocked."; needs moving(P), blocked(P), busy; leaves idle, refused(go).
- move go expire: "Going to {P} timed out: nothing came back in time."; needs moving(P), timeout, busy; leaves idle, expired(go).
- move find: "I start looking for {T}."; needs cmd find(T), idle, battery ok (kept); leaves searching(T), progress(find), busy.
- move find low: "I can't search: the battery is too low to search."; needs cmd find(T), battery low (kept); leaves refused(find).
- move find busy: "I can't take that now: I am already busy with a task."; needs cmd find(T), moving(P) (kept); leaves refused(find).
- move find busy find: "I can't take that now: I am already searching."; needs cmd find(T), searching(U) (kept); leaves refused(find).
- move find busy follow: "I can't take that now: I am following you."; needs cmd find(T), following (kept); leaves refused(find).
- move found: "I found {T}."; needs searching(T), spotted(T), unseen(T), busy; leaves seen(T), idle, done(find).
- move found again: "I found {T} again."; needs searching(T), spotted(T), seen(T) (kept), busy; leaves idle, done(find).
- move find locked: "I can't reach {T}: it is locked away."; needs searching(T), locked away(T), busy; leaves idle, refused(find).
- move find expire: "The search for {T} timed out: nothing found in time."; needs searching(T), timeout, busy; leaves idle, expired(find).
- move follow: "I follow you."; needs cmd follow, idle, posture(standing) (kept), person in view (kept); leaves following, progress(follow), busy.
- move follow nobody: "I can't follow: no person is in view."; needs cmd follow, nobody (kept); leaves refused(follow).
- move follow must stand: "I can't follow yet: I have to stand up first."; needs cmd follow, idle (kept), person in view (kept), posture(Q) (kept), other(Q,standing); leaves refused(follow).
- move follow busy: "I can't take that now: I am already busy with a task."; needs cmd follow, moving(P) (kept); leaves refused(follow).
- move follow busy find: "I can't take that now: I am already searching."; needs cmd follow, searching(T) (kept); leaves refused(follow).
- move follow already: "I am already following you."; needs cmd follow, following (kept); leaves refused(follow).
- move follow lost: "I lost you: nobody is in view any more."; needs following, lost, busy; leaves idle, expired(follow).
- move stop go: "I stop going to {P}."; needs cmd stop, moving(P), busy; leaves idle, done(stop), cancelled(go).
- move stop find: "I stop searching for {T}."; needs cmd stop, searching(T), busy; leaves idle, done(stop), cancelled(find).
- move stop follow: "I stop following you."; needs cmd stop, following, busy; leaves idle, done(stop), cancelled(follow).
- move stop still: "I am already stopped."; needs cmd stop, idle (kept); leaves refused(stop).
- move cancel go: "Okay, I drop that: I am no longer going to {P}."; needs cmd cancel, moving(P), busy; leaves idle, done(cancel), cancelled(go).
- move cancel find: "Okay, I drop the search for {T}."; needs cmd cancel, searching(T), busy; leaves idle, done(cancel), cancelled(find).
- move cancel follow: "Okay, I stop following you."; needs cmd cancel, following, busy; leaves idle, done(cancel), cancelled(follow).
- move cancel none: "Okay: there was nothing to drop."; needs cmd cancel, idle (kept); leaves done(cancel).
- move query seen: "I tell you about {T}: last seen at {P}."; needs cmd query(T), seen(T) (kept), where(T,P) (kept); leaves done(query).
- move query unseen: "I can't say about {T}: not seen yet."; needs cmd query(T), unseen(T) (kept); leaves refused(query).
- move look: "I tell you what I see around {P}: it is on my map."; needs cmd look(P), mapped(P) (kept); leaves done(look).
- move look unmapped: "I can't look at {P}: it is not on my map."; needs cmd look(P), unmapped(P) (kept); leaves refused(look).
- move time: "I tell you the time."; needs cmd time; leaves done(time).
- move date: "I tell you the date."; needs cmd date; leaves done(date).
- move chat: "I answer in kind."; needs cmd chat; leaves done(chat).
- move unknown: "I can't do that: it is not something I can or may do."; needs cmd unknown; leaves refused(unknown).
- things it counts: posture; at; idle; moving; searching; following; seen; where; unseen; battery ok; battery low; floor dry; floor wet; free; obstacle; clear; wall; leg ok; leg hot; mapped; unmapped; open; closed; person in view; nobody; arrived; blocked; spotted; locked away; lost; timeout; cmd stand; cmd sit; cmd lie; cmd turn; cmd move; cmd paw; busy; cmd go; cmd find; cmd follow; cmd stop; cmd cancel; cmd query; cmd look; cmd time; cmd date; cmd chat; cmd unknown; done; refused; progress; expired; cancelled
